pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time: pick the stack step below the 37.5 kg of Pull A and aim for 10 to 12.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: start near the 20 kg of your cable row and add a step if 12 feels easy.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: pick a dumbbell of about 12 kg, aim for 10 to 12, left arm first.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: pick a light rope weight you can pull to your face 18 times, elbows high.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg and go past 15: you did 15 a side on 19 Nov in a 12 to 20 range.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells a little heavier than your 5 kg incline curl and aim for 12.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: light dumbbells of about 6 to 8 kg a hand, aim for 10 a leg, left leg first.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: pick a weight you could lift about 14 times and stop at 12.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Same 20 kg, more reps: 12 on every set, so go for 14.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: First time: pick a weight that gives about 15 with 2 reps left, with a full stretch at the bottom.

legsB:hanging-leg-raise.coach: First time: legs straight and slow, aim for 10 to 12, bend the knees if your form breaks.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Try 15 kg dumbbells again for 6, and drop to 12.5 kg if you get 5 again.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Same 10 kg, more reps: 8 on every set, so go for 10.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg, the top plate: the stack jumps to 10 kg, which gave only 7, so lower slowly and go to failure.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Same 30 kg: the second set gave 8, so get 12 on both first.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Same 25 kg, more reps: 10 on every set, so go for 12.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Stay at 4 kg and go to failure: 15 on every set on 19 Nov, with reps left.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Same 37.5 kg, the stack's real step: 8 on every set, so go for 9 to 10.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Up one step to 25 kg: every set reached 12.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Same 20 kg: 14 on every set, one rep from the top, so go for 15.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Same 10 kg, more reps: 12 on every set in a 12 to 20 range.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg and go to failure: 15 a side on 19 Nov in a 12 to 20 range.

pullA:curl.coach: Same 5 kg: 10 on every set, so go for 12, then up.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Up one step: add 10 kg of plates to the empty sled, because every set reached 12.

legsA:rdl.coach: Up one step to 25 kg: every set reached 10.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Same 20 kg, more reps: 12 on every set, so go for 14.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Same 10 kg, slow: 12 on both sets, so go for 14.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Same 20 kg, more reps: 12 on every set, so go for 14.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Bodyweight, more reps: 12 on every set, so go for 14.

pushB:incline-press.coach: Up one step to 15 kg: every set reached 12 at 10 kg.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Up one step to 15 kg: every set reached 12 at 12.5 kg.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Stay at 4 kg and go to failure: 15 on every set in a 12 to 20 range.

pushB:dips.coach: Same 30 kg, more reps: 8 on every set, so go for 10.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: Same 15 kg, more reps: 12 on every set, so go for 14.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg and go to failure: 15 a side last time in a 15 to 20 range.

cable-lateral.note: 5 kg is the top plate, no pin.

pull-up.note: Machine has 37.5 kg, so all sets were that weight.

reverse-fly.note: Shoulder pain on the first set.

dips.note: I can pump dips but i love machines more.
